claim.claim-text: 1. A headband assembly, wherein the headband assembly comprises a head-mounting part (1) that is for clinging to and being worn on a head and connecting parts (2) that are connected to two sides of the head-mounting part (1) and are for connecting a respiratory mask; and the head-mounting part (1) comprises an upper headband (11) that is for clinging to a top of the head and a rear headband (12) that is for clinging to a rear side of the head and is located under the upper headband (11), wherein the upper headband (11) and the connecting parts (2) are of a planar structure in a spread and deployed state.

2. The headband assembly according to claim 1, wherein when the headband assembly is worn on the head, the upper headband (11) having the preset width has a plurality of micro-surfaces, and centers of curvature of the plurality of micro-surfaces are in a same plane.
3. The headband assembly according to claim 1, wherein the upper headband (11) is of a structure whose width is not constant.
4. The headband assembly according to claim 3, wherein widths of two ends of the upper headband (11) are greater than a width of a middle part of the upper headband (11).
5. The headband assembly according to any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein the rear headband (12) and the upper headband (11) form a non-detachable closed-loop structure.

6. The headband assembly according to any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein the rear headband (12) comprises a first band body (121) and a second band body (122) that are connected to two ends of the upper headband (11) and a third band body (123) that connects the first band body (121) and the second band body (122); and the third band body (123) comprises a third bottom band (1231) that connects one end of the first band body (121) that is further away from the upper headband (11) and one end of the second band body (122) that is further away from the upper headband (11) and/or a third middle band (1232) connected to a middle portion of the first band body (121) and a middle portion of the second band body (122).

7. The headband assembly according to claim 6, wherein ends of the first band body (121) and the second band body (122) that are further away from the upper headband (11) are inclined toward each other and are connected.
8. The headband assembly according to claim 7, an included angle between the first band body (121) and the second band body (122) is 20°-70°.

9. The headband assembly according to any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein each of the connecting parts (2) comprises a side headband (21) that is connected to one side of the upper headband (11) and a bottom headband (22) that is connected to one side of the rear headband (12).

10. The headband assembly according to claim 9, wherein one end of the side headband (21) that is further away from the upper headband (11) and one end of the bottom headband (22) that is further away from the rear headband (12) are connected to form a connecting band.
11. The headband assembly according to any one of claims 1 to 10, wherein the headband assembly is integrally formed.
12. The headband assembly according to any one of claims 1 to 10, wherein the headband assembly is of a symmetrical structure.
13. The headband assembly according to any one of claims 1 to 10, wherein the upper headband (11) is of a one-piece integral structure.

14. A respiratory-mask system, wherein the respiratory-mask system comprises a respiratory mask and the headband assembly according to any one of claims 1-13, and the respiratory mask is connected to the connecting parts (2) on two sides of the headband assembly.
